title: Fresh request catalogue and Rasen Falcon website projection
summary: dev4 adds fresh per-request StoryCatalogueSnapshot, independent intention-source proposals, an exact catalogue-revision authority receipt, fail-closed HOLD and a data-only StorySiteProjection; no website publication or transport authority is created.
invariants: The runtime must fetch a detached catalogue snapshot for every decideLive request; no long-lived process-level cached approval is sufficient.
A HOLD, missing snapshot or malformed snapshot blocks selection without narrative content.
Trusted gateway review is bound to the exact catalogue revision as well as request, tenant, market, locale, channel, claims, intention/narrative revisions and operative policy selection.
The in-memory snapshot and authority result are message shapes, never signatures; the gateway must inspect its actual authoritative CMS, Brand and Institutional Policy sources.
StorySiteProjection is a candidate only and does not create HTML, approved resource receipts, a Wire Site Release, DNS/TLS configuration or SMTP delivery.
Rasen Falcon delivery v0.4.5 is not running production HTTPS and CMS Brand Builder service contract is not yet independently verified.
r13196 execution and live multi-node revocation qualification are outstanding; static checks alone do not grant release.

provenance.claim: Source candidate generated from dev3, qualification pending
